name: lumo-browser
description: Lumo MVP: Windows-first Chromium browser with Orbit branding, vertical overlay tabs, session, search/network settings, managed site permissions, bookmark import/export, browsing-data controls, persistent site shortcuts, new-tab intro flash prevention, history, and downloads.

scripts.check: node --check src/core.js && node --check src/bookmarks.js && node --check src/permissions.js && node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/tab-preload.js && node --check src/settings-preload.js && node --check src/sidebar-preload.js && node --check src/sidebar.js && node --check src/renderer.js && node --check src/newtab.js && node --check src/settings.js && node --check src/library.js && node --check src/library-preload.js && node --check scripts/check-release-config.js && node scripts/check-release-config.js
scripts.pack:win: npm run check && npm test && npx --yes electron-builder@26 --win --dir --x64
scripts.dist:win:installer: npm run check && npm test && npx --yes electron-builder@26 --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:win:portable: npm run check && npm test && npx --yes electron-builder@26 --win portable --x64
